summary: Agent offered to place an order and requested full card details without verifying the account. No other policy violations observed in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: if you know which item you would like to purchase, I can take down your credit card number and expiration date
findings.explanation: The agent explicitly asks to take down the customer's full credit card number and expiration date. Policy forbids asking for or recording full payment card numbers or security codes; payment cards may only be referred to by their last four digits.

findings.quote: I can place your order for you, if you'd like
findings.explanation: The agent offers to place an order (an account/order action) but there is no evidence the agent pulled up the customer's account first (no 'Account has been pulled up' or similar system log). Policy requires pulling up the account (full name or account ID) before any account or order action.
